_notes: Every family + axis range below was fetched from fonts.googleapis.com/css2 on 2026-10-20 and returned 200.
display.min_px is the smallest size the display face may be used at with display.weight; below that the generator falls back to the body face.

display.vars is the font-variation-settings string that is ALWAYS applied with font-optical-sizing:none when the family has an opsz axis. Lesson from Stonehurst v1: Bodoni Moda's automatic optical size thinned hairlines to ~1px at 60-90px; pinning a low opsz and weight 500 fixed it.
class values: didone, garalde, transitional, scotch, slab, soft-serif, grotesk, geometric-sans, humanist-sans, inscriptional.

axes: formality (0 rustic .. 100 refined), scale (0 intimate .. 100 grand), era (0 heritage .. 100 modern), density (0 lush .. 100 minimal), temperature (0 warm .. 100 cool), voice (0 romantic .. 100 editorial).

2026-10-20 (dialects stage 2A): 16 pairings added from 05-luxury-dialects-spec.md section 2 (the spec inventory says 14; its dialect blocks name 16). Import strings checked against fonts.googleapis.com/css2 (docs/research/fonts-check.txt, and build.py re-verifies the chosen pairing at build time via lib/fonts.py). Rules enforced by lib/fonts.validate_pairings: display weight 400-600, never 100-300; has_opsz => vars pins opsz; didone class => risk names the hairline caution. display.case: sentence | caps | mixed. secondary: an optional second display face for headings when the primary is caps-only or wordmark-only. dialects: which dialects list this pairing.
